Sequential commutators alone non-circularly force the determinant-twisted axial-vector closure used by the Cycle-091 n=3 selector.
A full bivector-sector identification Lambda^2 V ~= V tensor det can be dimension-preserving only for positive n=3.
so(n), exterior bivectors, Hodge duality, and the 3D axial hat-map identity are established mathematics.
Random O(n) conjugation and O(3) axial-hat covariance checks agree with the exact identities.
PDT primitives independently require a vector-sized closed primitive generator sector rather than the generic bivector sector.
